licences.title: Licences, certificates and documents
licences.subtitle: Every licence a company needs, with its number, dates and whether it is valid today · a missing or lapsed licence stops the step that depends on it · Admin only
licences.dialogHint: Type the number and dates exactly as printed on the licence. A renewal is a new end date; the old values stay in the transaction log.
licences.toHelp: Leave empty if it has no expiry.
licences.emptyBody: Production of cosmetics and other licensed products is blocked until Admin records the licence here.
licences.adminOnly: Only Admin records licences. Ask Admin to add or renew one.

how.block: A process family names the licence it needs. Without a valid one, planning a batch and every production step of that family is refused.
how.paper: Numbers and dates come from the original paper; nothing is filled in by the system.
how.renew: On renewal, change the end date (or add the new licence). Old values are kept in the transaction log.
how.audit: Who added or changed a licence, and when, is recorded and can't be edited.
